objects.name: core_ctrl
objects.description:
| core_ctrl | Host loading, image/frame validity, stage sequence, output transfer, completion code | All N output transfers accepted, or one held error report |
Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

objects.name: embedding_ctrl
objects.description:
| embedding_ctrl | Token loop, FEATURE-to-TOKEN copy, norm/linear/norm calls, VECTOR-to-X copy | All X writes committed |
Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

objects.name: position_ctrl
objects.description:
| position_ctrl | m/n/feature loops, P/E reads, widened additions/conversions | All enriched X writes committed |
Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

objects.name: encoder_ctrl
objects.description:
| encoder_ctrl | k loop, layer-specific parameter descriptor | K successful layer responses accepted |
Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

objects.name: layer_ctrl
objects.description:
| layer_ctrl | LN1 sweep, attention, residual1 sweep, LN2 sweep, FFN/residual2 token loop | All second-residual X writes committed |
Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

objects.name: attention_ctrl
objects.description:
| attention_ctrl | QKV phase, head/query loops, query-mask read, score/softmax/weighted sequence, output projection | All ATTN_OUT writes committed |
Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

objects.name: qkv_ctrl
objects.description:
| qkv_ctrl | Projection selection Q then KEY then VALUE; token loop | All three LD projection arrays committed |
Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

objects.name: score_row_ctrl
objects.description:
| score_row_ctrl | Key loop for one fixed head/query, dot/scale, SCORE writes | One complete L-element score row committed |
Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

objects.name: softmax_ctrl
objects.description:
| softmax_ctrl | Max pass, exp/store/sum pass, reciprocal, probability write pass or uniform bypass | All L probability writes committed |
Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

objects.name: weighted_value_ctrl
objects.description:
| weighted_value_ctrl | Feature loop within fixed head/query, probability-by-V dots | d Z components committed |
Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

objects.name: output_projection_ctrl
objects.description:
| output_projection_ctrl | Token loop, Z-to-ATTN_OUT linear calls | All ATTN_OUT tokens committed |
Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

objects.name: ffn_ctrl
objects.description:

Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

objects.name: residual_ctrl
objects.description:

Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

objects.name: final_ctrl
objects.description:
| final_ctrl | Token loop, D-to-1 linear calls | L LOGIT values committed |
Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

objects.name: aggregation_ctrl
objects.description:

Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

objects.name: layernorm_ctrl
objects.description:

Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

objects.name: linear_ctrl

objects.name: parameter_mem
objects.description: Implemented behavioral RTL adapter. Native-width storage; IDLE -> WAIT_ACCESS -> RESPONSE; RESPONSE_DELAY >=1; successful write response follows commitment. Reset cancels pending access, retains committed words. Depth defaults zero and must be configured. Physical SRAM implementation unresolved.

objects.name: scratch_mem
objects.description: Implemented behavioral RTL adapter. Native-width storage; IDLE -> WAIT_ACCESS -> RESPONSE; RESPONSE_DELAY >=1; successful write response follows commitment. Reset cancels pending access, retains committed words. Depth defaults zero and must be configured. Physical SRAM implementation unresolved.

objects.name: 0 PARAM
objects.description:
Logical bank, not a separate SRAM macro. Capacity/format (provisional): PARAM_WORDS, signed16/F10
Producer: Core host loader while idle
Consumer: Position, LayerNorm, linear bias reads, dot weight reads

objects.name: 1 FEATURE
objects.description:
Logical bank, not a separate SRAM macro. Capacity/format (provisional): L*F, signed16/F10
Producer: Core feature loader
Consumer: Embedding copy loop

objects.name: 2 MASK
objects.description:
Logical bank, not a separate SRAM macro. Capacity/format (provisional): L, bit
Producer: Core mask loader
Consumer: Attention query flag; aggregation

objects.name: 3 X
objects.description:
Logical bank, not a separate SRAM macro. Capacity/format (provisional): L*D, signed16/F10
Producer: Embedding, position, residual
Consumer: Position, LayerNorm, residual, final dot

objects.name: 4 U
objects.description:
Logical bank, not a separate SRAM macro. Capacity/format (provisional): L*D, signed16/F10
Producer: LayerNorm 1, then LayerNorm 2 after residual 1
Consumer: Q/K/V dot, then FFN dot

objects.name: 5 Q
objects.description:
Logical bank, not a separate SRAM macro. Capacity/format (provisional): L*D, signed16/F10
Producer: Q linear
Consumer: Score dot

objects.name: 6 KEY
objects.description:
Logical bank, not a separate SRAM macro. Capacity/format (provisional): L*D, signed16/F10
Producer: K linear
Consumer: Score dot

objects.name: 7 VALUE
objects.description:
Logical bank, not a separate SRAM macro. Capacity/format (provisional): L*D, signed16/F10
Producer: V linear
Consumer: Weighted dot

objects.name: 8 Z
objects.description:
Logical bank, not a separate SRAM macro. Capacity/format (provisional): L*D, signed16/F10
Producer: Weighted controller
Consumer: Output-projection dot

objects.name: 9 ATTN_OUT
objects.description:
Logical bank, not a separate SRAM macro. Capacity/format (provisional): L*D, signed16/F10
Producer: Output-projection linear
Consumer: First residual

objects.name: 10 TOKEN
objects.description:
Logical bank, not a separate SRAM macro. Capacity/format (provisional): max(F,D), signed16/F10
Producer: Embedding copy, input LayerNorm
Consumer: LayerNorm, embedding dot

objects.name: 11 FFN_HIDDEN
objects.description:
Logical bank, not a separate SRAM macro. Capacity/format (provisional): 4D, signed16/F10
Producer: First FFN linear, then in-place GELU write loop
Consumer: GELU read loop, then second FFN linear's dot

objects.name: 12 VECTOR
objects.description:
Logical bank, not a separate SRAM macro. Capacity/format (provisional): max(D,4D), signed16/F10
Producer: Embedding linear/LN; second FFN linear
Consumer: Embedding copy/LN, second residual

objects.name: 13 SCORE
objects.description:
Logical bank, not a separate SRAM macro. Capacity/format (provisional): L, signed48/F20
Producer: Score controller
Consumer: Softmax

objects.name: 14 EXP
objects.description:
Logical bank, not a separate SRAM macro. Capacity/format (provisional): L, unsigned24/F22
Producer: Softmax
Consumer: Softmax

objects.name: 15 PROB
objects.description:
Logical bank, not a separate SRAM macro. Capacity/format (provisional): L, unsigned24/F22
Producer: Softmax
Consumer: Weighted dot

objects.name: 16 LOGIT
objects.description:
Logical bank, not a separate SRAM macro. Capacity/format (provisional): L, signed16/F10
Producer: Final linear
Consumer: Aggregation

objects.name: 17 OUTPUT
objects.description:
Logical bank, not a separate SRAM macro. Capacity/format (provisional): N, signed16/F10
Producer: Aggregation
Consumer: Core output transfer

edges.name: bank 0 · PARAM
edges.description: Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. PARAM_WORDS, signed16/F10; producer: Core host loader while idle; consumer: Position, LayerNorm, linear bias reads, dot weight reads

edges.name: bank 1 · FEATURE
edges.description: Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L*F, signed16/F10; producer: Core feature loader; consumer: Embedding copy loop

edges.name: bank 2 · MASK
edges.description: Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L, bit; producer: Core mask loader; consumer: Attention query flag; aggregation

edges.name: bank 3 · X
edges.description: Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L*D, signed16/F10; producer: Embedding, position, residual; consumer: Position, LayerNorm, residual, final dot

edges.name: bank 4 · U
edges.description: Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L*D, signed16/F10; producer: LayerNorm 1, then LayerNorm 2 after residual 1; consumer: Q/K/V dot, then FFN dot

edges.name: bank 5 · Q
edges.description: Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L*D, signed16/F10; producer: Q linear; consumer: Score dot

edges.name: bank 6 · KEY
edges.description: Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L*D, signed16/F10; producer: K linear; consumer: Score dot

edges.name: bank 7 · VALUE
edges.description: Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L*D, signed16/F10; producer: V linear; consumer: Weighted dot

edges.name: bank 8 · Z
edges.description: Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L*D, signed16/F10; producer: Weighted controller; consumer: Output-projection dot

edges.name: bank 9 · ATTN_OUT
edges.description: Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L*D, signed16/F10; producer: Output-projection linear; consumer: First residual

edges.name: bank 10 · TOKEN
edges.description: Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. max(F,D), signed16/F10; producer: Embedding copy, input LayerNorm; consumer: LayerNorm, embedding dot

edges.name: bank 11 · FFN_HIDDEN
edges.description: Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. 4D, signed16/F10; producer: First FFN linear, then in-place GELU write loop; consumer: GELU read loop, then second FFN linear's dot

edges.name: bank 12 · VECTOR
edges.description: Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. max(D,4D), signed16/F10; producer: Embedding linear/LN; second FFN linear; consumer: Embedding copy/LN, second residual

edges.name: bank 13 · SCORE
edges.description: Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L, signed48/F20; producer: Score controller; consumer: Softmax

edges.name: bank 14 · EXP
edges.description: Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L, unsigned24/F22; producer: Softmax; consumer: Softmax

edges.name: bank 15 · PROB
edges.description: Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L, unsigned24/F22; producer: Softmax; consumer: Weighted dot

edges.name: bank 16 · LOGIT
edges.description: Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. L, signed16/F10; producer: Final linear; consumer: Aggregation

edges.name: bank 17 · OUTPUT
edges.description: Internal decoded native-width storage, not a new external RTL interface. N, signed16/F10; producer: Aggregation; consumer: Core output transfer
